stage_1_30_phase_strobe.operator: L_clock tensor I + I tensor L_matter
stage_1_30_phase_strobe.purpose: test that prepared support lies in the coupled eigenvalue-30 sector

minimal_protocol: prepare support in the coupled 30-sector using BT1658 polynomial projectors
run the coupled 30-strobe at tau=pi/15 and measure return visibility
run the partial-clock separator at tau=pi/6 and read the -1 versus +1 split
run the matter-gap probe at tau=pi/24 to cross-check 24-gap support
boundary: This is a graph-spectral timing contract. Optical loss, detector dark counts, and calibration drift belong to the separate guard-shell hardware budget.
